edges.reason: transfer delegates balance subtraction to SafeMath.sub.
transfer delegates balance addition to SafeMath.add.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance subtraction to SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom delegates balance addition to SafeMath.add.

sellsIntermediateGoodWithDepletion computes tokens*out2inIngredientPercentage/100 with unchecked arithmetic.
comminglerSellsProductSKUWithProRataIngred invokes transferAndWriteUrl twice with computed quantities.

comminglerSellsProductSKUWithProRataIngred evaluates (_numSKUsSold-1)*_qttyIGRinLLSKU without guards.
totalSupply performs the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
the constructor computes the fixed supply with an unchecked multiplication.
approveAndCall performs an external call to the caller-supplied spender contract.
the spender contract regains control during receiveApproval and can re-enter the token.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token address.
the arbitrary token contract executes code during the external transfer call.
the onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership is gated on require(msg.sender == newOwner).
